Scope and known limits

The new whole-leg treatment is available for the resident only. Selecting it switches to her; selecting the neighbor switches to the previous painting. Each leg has independent artwork from hip to shoe, with smooth knee weighting. The previous version held the upper thigh too still and stretched two overlapping legs in one painting.

The upper body keeps its subtle rise and fall. Arms still rest, and the waist and knee bends still need visual review. This walking-only study has not replaced the door and flower interactions.
